megacorp_caravaneer_init = {
	class = "rl_standard_stars"
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				has_megacorp = yes
				caravaneers_enabled = yes
				add = 100
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				OR = {
					is_fe_cluster = yes
					is_marauder_cluster = yes
				}
			}
			modifier = {
				factor = 0
				has_star_flag = empire_cluster
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	flags = { caravaneer_home enclave }
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Caravaneer_Home" type = caravaneer_home }
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet1_country" type = caravaneer_fleet }
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet2" type = caravaneer_fleet }
		create_country = { name = "NAME_Caravaneer_Fleet3" type = caravaneer_fleet }
	}
}
